idea-plugin.name: Kshana - PNT simulator
idea-plugin.description:
Run Kshana — the open, reproducible positioning/navigation/timing (PNT) resilience simulator — directly from your JetBrains IDE.

Right-click any scenario .toml and choose Run Kshana Scenario; the figures of merit and result JSON stream into the Kshana tool window. Set the path to the kshana binary in Settings → Tools → Kshana (install it with cargo install kshana).

Also on the context menu: Assess Receiver Trust (a receiver-log scenario, with a 0-100 score and reasons for a vessel; advisory), Generate Training NMEA (synthetic bridge NMEA with an instructor log; text only, training use), Build Interference Map (ADS-B or AIS CSV to GeoJSON), Route Exposure, Export Test-Bench Files (motion, NMEA and events for a laboratory simulator; no signal is written) and Build Compliance Report / Show Compliance Mapping (the public-framework mapping, shown with the engine's own statement) Verify Evidence Pack (against the signer's public key you supply), Create Evidence Pack and Attach Timestamp (the signing key and the timestamp token are yours; the plugin never makes or stores a key), Insert Example Scenario, Export Scenario, Animate Scenario and Import Route. The long-running receiver-trust live process stays on the command line.

Scenarios cover SGP4/SDP4 orbits, IAU reference frames, Allan deviations, GNSS availability/DOP, ARAIM protection levels, GNSS/INS fusion, and quantum-sensor models — each carrying an explicit, machine-checkable verification status (validated against an external oracle, or transparently modelled). See https://kshana.dev.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.35.0 — new context-menu actions: Assess Receiver Trust, Generate Training NMEA, Build Interference Map, Route Exposure, Export Test-Bench Files, Build Compliance Report and Verify Evidence Pack, Create Evidence Pack, Attach Timestamp, Insert Example Scenario, Export Scenario, Animate Scenario and Import Route, and Tools → Show Compliance Mapping. Each runs the engine's command line and shows its output with the caveat that belongs with it; advisory use only. The plugin needs a kshana engine 0.35.0 or newer for these actions. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.34.1 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release hardens the input handling of the engine's MCP server. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.34.0 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release adds the GNSS IQ tracking engine, detection monitors and the lab-replay campaign runner to the engine's command line and Python API. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.33.1 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release hardens the Kshana Studio and the chart text of the engine against untrusted scenario text. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.33.0 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release fixes GNSS IQ defects (front-end flags, per-signal data timing, GLONASS FDMA carriers, integer scaling) and changes the iq track default hand-off. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.32.0 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release surfaces the GNSS IQ signal layer on the engine's command line and Python API. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.31.0 — the plugin itself is unchanged; this release adds the GNSS IQ signal layer to the engine. Update the engine with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.30.0 — the plugin itself is unchanged since 0.22.0; every release since has been the same build republished so the Marketplace version keeps matching the kshana engine it targets. All the work is in the engine — update it separately with cargo install kshana and see the release notes at https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/releases.
0.22.0 — the plugin now versions in lockstep with the Kshana engine, so the Marketplace version always matches the kshana release it targets. This build is also relicensed to AGPL-3.0-only (a commercial licence is available from Ashforde OÜ; see the repository's LICENSING.md) — no functional change to the plugin itself, but it brings the published artifact in line with the open-source engine's current licence.
0.1.1 — maintenance release; first build delivered through continuous publishing. Requires the kshana CLI (cargo install kshana); compatible with JetBrains IDEs 2024.3 and newer.

action.description: Run the selected TOML as a Kshana scenario
Run kshana receiver-trust on the selected scenario TOML: a trust timeline, with a 0-100 score and reasons for a vessel. Advisory only.
Run kshana nmea-scenario on the selected TOML: synthetic bridge NMEA and an instructor log, for training only.
Run kshana interference-map on the selected ADS-B or AIS CSV: one GeoJSON per UTC day, aggregate only.
Run kshana route-exposure: the share of the selected route through degraded cells of a folder of interference maps.
Run kshana bench-export on the selected scenario TOML: vehicle motion, NMEA and labelled events for a laboratory GNSS simulator. No signal is written.
Run kshana compliance-report on the selected run result JSON: the public-framework mapping filled from the run, with its gap column.
Run kshana evidence verify on the selected evidence-pack folder against the signer's public key you supply. Never accepts an unpinned signer.
Run kshana example: list the bundled scenarios and write the one you pick as a new .toml.
Run the selected scenario and export it as SP3, OMM, OEM, CZML, KML, GeoJSON, STK or SigMF. Simulated output only.
Run the selected scenario with --animate and open the HTML or SVG animation.
Run a scenario with the selected GeoJSON route (--import-route).
Run kshana receiver-trust evidence on the selected session TOML for a time window, signed with a key file you choose. The plugin never makes or stores a key.
Run kshana evidence attach-timestamp: add an RFC 3161 token you obtained to the selected evidence pack. The authority's signature is not checked by Kshana.
Run kshana compliance-report --mapping: the static public-framework mapping tables.
